brief: An island-town cottage lot: Capt Gilchrist Sr House 3, a 19th-century Lake Erie house; see the photo for its massing, porch and trim. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: the Lake Erie shore towns that stand in for Victory Bay's island streets (Vermilion, Sandusky, Put-in-Bay) were built 1840-1920, and Commons has almost no newer cottages there. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the Capt. Gilchrist Sr. House (Vermilion): a red-painted Italianate gable-front-and-wing house with white arched window hoods and brackets, a glazed sunporch on the front, a long one-storey wing with a porch; a corner lawn and a concrete curb

why.note: Vermilion OH: Lake Erie ship captains' houses of the 1840s-80s (the 'village of lake captains')
